import csv
date="2018-04-12"
sid_sensor="c1021e2f-bb67-5120-895b-3a425fb6ff0a"
sid_heat="581c2206-b265-5578-9b1e-422601278628"
sid_cool="131a6a13-5101-5d88-a675-688386d58b1f"
data={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r["timeseries_id"] in (sid_sensor,sid_heat,sid_cool) and r["timestamp"].startswith(date):
            data.setdefault(r["timeseries_id"],{})[r["timestamp"]]=float(r["value"])
ts=sorted(data[sid_sensor].keys())
print("num",len(ts))
out=0
outdetail=[]
for t in ts:
    s=data[sid_sensor][t]
    h=data[sid_heat].get(t)
    c=data[sid_cool].get(t)
    if h is None and c is None:
        outdetail.append((t,s,h,c,"nomissing"))
        continue
    bad=False
    if h is not None and s < h: bad=True
    if c is not None and s > c: bad=True
    if bad: out+=1
    outdetail.append((t,s,h,c,bad))
for d in outdetail:
    print(d)
print("OUT_OF_BAND:",out)
